Title: General availability: Critical Update 5.0 for StorSimple 8000 Series

Body.Content:
A critical update (Update 5.0) was released for Microsoft Azure StorSimple 8000 Series. We strongly recommend that you install Update 5.0. 

Devices running Update 4.0 or earlier will have service connectivity issues after December 2017.

For detailed instructions on how to apply the update, go to the Install Update 5 on your StorSimple device documentation webpage.
